note: Self-assessment by the developer for the owner; not legal advice. Source: docs/compliance/gdpr.md. Statuses: compliant, partial, open.

controls.requirement: Health data processed only with explicit consent
controls.evidence: Consent at sign-in and a separate health-data consent; terms v17 accepted and recorded (acceptances, text fingerprint)

controls.requirement: Privacy notice names the controller (name, address, contact)
controls.evidence: Gap G1: the owner's name and postal address are missing
controls.next: Human gives name/business name and address

controls.requirement: Only the data needed: no name, no email, no documents
controls.evidence: Google account as HMAC only; lab documents never leave the phone; only report date and values as printed; logs without values

controls.requirement: Each kind of data kept only as long as its purpose needs
controls.evidence: Blood pressure 365 days (nightly purge); lab results until the user deletes them (purpose: complete history, user-controlled); errors and events 90 days; sessions and links 7 days

controls.requirement: Encrypted transport and authenticated requests
controls.evidence: HTTPS/TLS only (Cloudflare, TLS 1.3 when supported); every app request signed with a key kept on the phone; replay protection

controls.requirement: Stored data protected against unauthorised access
controls.evidence: Only the Worker reaches D1; the owner's Anthropic key for the Scan is a Worker secret (never in D1 or the repository); nobody adds an AI key of their own; codes, cookies, links and files as fingerprints. Health values are not field-encrypted and D1 disk encryption is not stated in Cloudflare's documentation we checked. The Scan trial is counted on HMAC fingerprints of the Google account and the phone (scan_trials), never an email or a raw id, kept at most 2 years after the account is deleted, only to prevent a second trial. The owner's powers (Admin console, versions, settings) work only from the owner's phone on record (owner_key); a new phone needs the owner's secret code (OWNER_CODE, 5 tries a day) or the GitHub workflow Owner phone. Acceptances of the terms are copied to a second EU database (personalhealthy-backup) at each acceptance and every night, as legal proof.
controls.next: Decide whether to encrypt lab and pressure values per account

controls.requirement: Data stored in the EU
controls.evidence: D1 database bound to the EU jurisdiction; the Worker may run at a Cloudflare edge outside the EU (stated in terms and privacy, gap G4)
controls.next: Regional services (paid) if required after legal review

controls.requirement: Transfers named, with safeguards
controls.evidence: Google (sign-in, billing) and Anthropic (photo Scan, terms v21) outside the EU, named with DPF/SCC. The Scan (15-day trial, then the 4.99 USD AI features subscription; 3 a day, at most 2.50 USD of AI per person a year, tracked in scan_usage; Claude Haiku 4.5) sends the photo of the display alone through the Worker to Anthropic, which reads it as processor and does not train on it; the Worker neither stores nor logs it. Only the three confirmed numbers are stored; lab documents are never transferred
controls.next: Accept Anthropic's commercial terms and DPA on the owner's account; legal review of the wording (G3)

controls.requirement: Processor agreements checked and filed
controls.evidence: Gap G11: Cloudflare DPA acceptance on the account not yet confirmed
controls.next: Human confirms in the Cloudflare account

controls.requirement: Full export of one's data
controls.evidence: Web Dashboard shows all data, PDF of lab results and 7-day pressure report; no single machine-readable export of everything (G5)
controls.next: "Download all my data" (JSON/CSV) in the Web Dashboard

controls.requirement: Delete single data, all data, the account
controls.evidence: Readings, a lab date, all lab results, a report, or the whole account, immediately; acceptance record kept on legitimate interest

controls.requirement: Record of processing activities
controls.evidence: Draft kept in docs/compliance/gdpr.md section 5, updated with lab results

controls.requirement: DPIA for health data at scale
controls.evidence: Gap G9
controls.next: Claude drafts from the threat model, Human signs

controls.requirement: Notify the authority within 72 hours, users if high risk
controls.evidence: Gap G10; emergency switch-off of all apps exists (app_off)
controls.next: One-page procedure (who notices, decides, notifies FDPIC / Garante)

controls.requirement: Representative in the EU for a Swiss controller
controls.evidence: Gap G7

controls.requirement: Only technical cookies, after consent, declared
controls.evidence: One cookie (hint_s) after consent; the app uses none; declared in terms and privacy

controls.requirement: The owner never sees values, reports or names
controls.evidence: Admin shows totals and codes only; observability without values

controls.requirement: No diagnosis or interpretation
controls.evidence: No judgement or advice; the orange ↑/↓ only repeats the comparison with the reference printed on the report
controls.next: Legal review before the Play Store

controls.requirement: Known vulnerabilities found and fixed in time
controls.evidence: Nightly OSV/Semgrep/gitleaks scan, Dependabot, deadlines by severity; see the Security console

controls.requirement: Availability and resilience: data can be restored in time after an incident
controls.evidence: D1 Time Travel; nightly AES-256 encrypted export of both databases to an EU R2 bucket (30 days, 7-day lock); infrastructure declared in DR/infrastructure-as-code/infrastructure.json and rebuilt by DR/infrastructure-as-code/rebuild.sh; restore tested locally on 02.10.2026. Partial until the owner enables R2 and sets BACKUP_PASSPHRASE.
